verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for a relay server and its client libraries, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation of API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only related evidence is a community report that ANNOUNCE was replaced by PUBLISH_NAMESPACE and that an integration fell behind on protocol drafts, which shows breaking churn rather than a documented policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
